name: Nayifat Finance Company
summary: Operating as a non-banking financial institution, Nayifat Finance Company specializes in providing Shariah-compliant financing to individuals and businesses across the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. Its offerings encompass a range of financial products, including lease finance, funding for small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs), personal consumer loans, and credit card services. The company was founded in 2002 and is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.
